g.text: $ skygraph demo
skygraph demo — a sample shop: a Python API, an order service, stock, two
tables, a TypeScript client, a Dockerfile and a CI file.

→ create_order (shop/api.py)
→ Order (shop/models.py) → table orders
(derived — the handler calls the model)

expand_symbol · 591 bytes back to the agent
← OrderService.place (shop/orders.py)
4. What is affected if Inventory.reserve changes?
blast_radius · 288 bytes back to the agent
← OrderService.place (shop/orders.py)
← create_order (shop/api.py)
5. What does the TypeScript checkout call?

→ placeOrder (web/src/api.ts)

Each answer is what Claude Code or Codex receives through skygraph's fourteen
tools, instead of opening the files. The sample and its index were temporary and

Try it on your own code: skygraph init /path/to/your/project
